title: 3599. Partition Array to Minimize XOR

examples.explanation: The optimal partition is [1] and [2, 3]. XOR of the first subarray is 1. XOR of the second subarray is 2 XOR 3 = 1. The maximum XOR among the subarrays is 1, which is the minimum possible.

The optimal partition is [2], [3, 3], and [2]. XOR of the first subarray is 2. XOR of the second subarray is 3 XOR 3 = 0. XOR of the third subarray is 2. The maximum XOR among the subarrays is 2, which is the minimum possible.

The optimal partition is [1, 1] and [2, 3, 1]. XOR of the first subarray is 1 XOR 1 = 0. XOR of the second subarray is 2 XOR 3 XOR 1 = 0. The maximum XOR among the subarrays is 0, which is the minimum possible.

hints: Precompute pre[i] = nums[0] ^ … ^ nums[i-1] so any subarray XOR is pre[r] ^ pre[l].
Define dp[i][j] = minimum possible “max‑XOR” when splitting the first i elements into j parts.
For each dp[i][j], try all splits t < i and take the minimum over max(dp[t][j-1], pre[i] ^ pre[t]).
